symbols.name: family parameter
symbols.meaning: The index of a member of the family: a nonnegative integer that selects which construction is built and so fixes its size.
symbols.quote: Let $\tau$ be the family parameter: a nonnegative integer that indexes the members of a family.

symbols.name: family member
symbols.meaning: The construction in the family that is built with parameter tau.
symbols.quote: Let $C_\tau$ be the member of the family built with parameter $\tau$.
